comment: Thirty-eight rows: 5 for the original rules, 8 for the review repair rules, 6 for the final
repair and 19 for the cut rounds, the rebase on the parent and the delta reviews. They hold
the caller storage rules, the leaf-count reservation of a whole value and of the components
of a literal, the component result leaf, the incomplete base use, the private literal leaf,
the owning leaf in place, the address guards of in-place leaves, of an owning literal leaf
and of a direct and a projected whole effect, and the whole return of a flat struct literal.
No row holds the base use of a projected owner move in assign_output. FIR lowers that
move through a temporary, so no body reaches it, and its mutant survives every stage.
The build compiles only the focused test. The second stage uses the built debug compiler.
Run this table in the Linux VM after you build the debug preset.

stages.name: the summary suites
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --cc /usr/bin/clang --target x86_64-linux-gnu -j 6 ownership_calls_ ownership_recursive ownership_indirect ownership_summary_

        if (false && returned_borrow) { out->result_reference = true; }
